sources.identifier: Oh, Sung, Chun. 2019;18:222. doi:10.1186/s12944-019-1134-0. Explicitly selected PMC6911291.1.
sources.population: Healthy Twin Study, Korea; 1029 men and 1643 women; same-sex adult twins and relatives; excludes dyslipidemia or diabetes medication. Tables share participants, not independent confirmations. Abstract and Methods disagree on recruitment dates and age eligibility.
sources.measurement: TG mg/dL after >=12-hour fast. EDTA fasting plasma/Cobas 6000 in Methods; serum in title/tables. BMI kg/m^2. Table 1 mean/SD labels conflict with general log/geometric-average statement; source interpretation remains conditional.

sources.identifier: Bansal et al. JAMA 2007;298:309-316. doi:10.1001/jama.298.3.309. Published publisher text captured 2026-10-28; no numbered revision established.
sources.population: Women's Health Study initially healthy US women >=45, prevention-trial volunteers; fasting subgroup n=20118, >=8 hours self-reported. Distinct from Korean cohort; all tables within this paper overlap.
sources.measurement: EDTA plasma stored before assay; enzymatic TG with endogenous-glycerol correction, Hitachi/Roche. TG mg/dL. BMI kg/m^2. Serum transport is assumed. Right-skewed distribution and Spearman correlations explicitly stated.
